# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

## Formula-mode reads (cand_0002, pending RESULT)
- Observed: 45707, 48975 and 57354 read inputs from `load_workbook(path)` (no data_only), so formula sources were strings, giving empty output and resend loops. The fix is in the task_template Phase 2 code. Not yet confirmed by a RESULT.

## Filled target cells: preserve by default, with narrow exceptions (cand_0002 RESULT)
- What worked: cand_0002's preserve/"workbook wins" rules fixed many tasks (val +0.200).
- What didn't: the same rules broke 11276 (filled 'TU'/'W' cells are the complaint; golden = `%a` per the instruction's "Mon, Wed"). Case-sensitive matching broke 41978 (cand_0001's `.lower()` passed it).
- Promising (cand_0003, pending): test f on the filled cells (Phase 1c) and a printed SPELLING check instead of prose-only rules, which 203-15/1925/188-39 ignored.
